{{Infobox league |name=QWSL DIV2 |image=Qwsldiv2-logo.png |series= |organizer={{player|Hooraytio|flag=se}} {{player|Link|flag=no}} {{player|Doomie|flag=pl}} |sponsor= |type=Online |format=4on4 |prizepool= |sdate=2025.12.01 |edate=2026.03.29 |year=2025/26 |website= |discord=discord.gg/EaDUYqRDGM |twitch= |teamfirst= |teamfirstflag= |teamsecond= |teamsecondflag= |teamthird= |teamthirdflag= |teamfourth= |teamfourthflag= |team_number= |map1=dm2 |map2=dm3 |map3=e1m2 |map4=schloss |map5=qobblestone |map6=anwalked |map7=defer }} {{Tabs static |name1=Overview |link1=QWSL DIV2 |name2=Rules |link2=QWSL DIV2/rules |name3=Teams |link3=QWSL DIV2/teams |name4=Standings |link4=QWSL DIV2/standings |This=2 }} == Rules == ''Under construction!'' - This league is an '''European''' league, so we play on EU servers. - No cheating! - '''Ruleset''': Smackdown - '''SOCD'''. Socd is not allowed. However, by typing "/socd" in the console can also kick players who dont use it. So in any case, you need to look up after the game if anyone used socd. If so, and you report that to the admins, the admins will give that player a warning. If the player uses it again, that player will be banned from further games in the league. Remember, if you typed "ready", you agreed to all settings. - Any '''standins''' will be allowed as long as both teams agree. Get a standin with similar skill. - Late addons of players is allowed. '''Adding players mid-season''' is allowed as long as the team stays on the same level of skill, more or less. It is up the admins to decide if a player is allowed to be added or not. You can not add players after last group game. - '''Client''' and '''server''' issues: If the shitshow starts because teams cant type ready, for any reason, and we really have to write down every piece of detail in this section, so be it. Until that happens; play qw and be happy. - '''Ping'''. If one team requests that the other team needs to ping up, so be it. We dont want unfair pings, but there is also a limit; players from other regions than EU should not affect the teamping average. Standard rule is that adjusting the ping up to 38 should be the limit for low pingers. Do your best to get the team-average ping as even as possible. - '''Toss''' and '''pick''' procedures:
Group games: '''Go3''' - Do RND who toss first. Team1 toss first, Team2 pick first. Map 3: Do RND who toss first.
Playoffs: '''Bo5''' - Do RND who toss first. Team1 toss first, Team2 toss next. Lowest ranked team from division/group picks first. Loser picks next map and after every map played; the loser picks the next map from maps not yet tossed or played. - Match tag: '''/4on4 qwsldiv2'''. This is important because of the auto-scripts that report the game to the standings and the player stats. - '''Standings''' in the table are determined by:
1. Wins
2. Map difference
3. Internal fight
4. Frag difference internal fights (if 3 or more teams are tied in the above)
